idea-plugin.name: Awesome Android Wizard
idea-plugin.description:
Awesome Android Project Wizard

An interactive, enterprise-grade project and module scaffolding platform for Android Studio and IntelliJ IDEA.

  • Multi-Module Architecture: :app, :core:model, :core:data, :core:network, :core:database, :core:testing, :core:ui, :core:designsystem, :feature:*
  • Gradle Convention Plugins: Modern build-logic setup sharing compiler and plugins logic across modules
  • Version Catalog: Clean gradle/libs.versions.toml configured with latest stable dependencies
  • Jetpack Compose & Material 3: Edge-to-edge support, custom design tokens, and components
  • Configurable Tech Stack: Hilt vs Koin, Ktor vs Retrofit, Room database, Coroutines & Flow
  • Project Doctor & Guard: Architectural dependency enforcement and automated Git hooks
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0 - Step-by-Step Wizard Two-Way Synchronization, Architecture Dependency Cascading & Enterprise Pre-Flight Validation

  • Wizard Two-Way State Synchronization: Interactive live synchronization across all 5 wizard steps when switching architecture archetypes (Startup, Fintech, Minimal, Custom).
  • Prerequisite Dependency Auto-Cascading: Intelligent resolution guaranteeing :core:model, :core:data, :core:designsystem, and :core:ui are scaffolded whenever dependent feature modules exist.
  • Minimal / Single-Module Archetype Hardening: Standalone screen fallback and dynamic MaterialTheme resolution when features or designsystem modules are omitted.
  • Wear OS Companion Dependency Alignment: Added Wear Tiles and Guava Android dependencies to Version Catalog for out-of-the-box tile compilation.
  • Cross-Platform Android SDK Diagnostics: Enhanced Project Doctor candidate SDK path detection across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
  • Enterprise Pre-Flight Validation: Validates project names, package names, Windows reserved device names (CON, PRN, AUX, etc.), and folder permissions.

1.0.9 - Modular Component Scaffolders, Awesome Architecture Tool Window & Multiplatform Companion Modules

  • Awesome Architecture Tool Window: Interactive side panel with module dependency graph, Clean Architecture boundary auditor, circular dependency detection, and Version Catalog inspector.
  • MVI Feature Slice Scaffolder: One-click scaffolding of MVI Contract (State, Intent, Effect), ViewModel (Hilt or Koin), Compose Screen, Navigation 2.8+ route, and Turbine unit test.
  • Repository Slice Scaffolder: Instant generation of Domain Model, Network DTO + Mapper, Repository interface, Default implementation, and Test Fake.
  • Production Performance & Baseline Profiles: Automated :benchmark module generator with BaselineProfileGenerator and StartupBenchmark rules.
  • Wear OS Companion Scaffolder: Instant creation of :wear companion app with Wear Compose M3, TileService, and ambient mode.
  • Android Auto & Automotive Scaffolder: Automated :automotive module generation with AndroidX Car App Library, CarAppService, Session, and Screen templates.

1.0.7 - AGP 9.0+ Built-in Kotlin Support & Submodule SDK Alignment

  • Migrated all generated Android application and library module templates to AGP 9 built-in Kotlin support, removing legacy alias(libs.plugins.kotlin.android) collisions.
  • Added explicit compileSdk and minSdk configuration to :core:data and :core:network module templates.
  • Registered kotlin.jvm, hilt, and ksp plugins in root build.gradle.kts for clean subproject resolution.

1.0.6 - Device Form Factor (Mobile/Tablet/TV/Adaptive) & Theme Customization

  • Added interactive 'Device & Theme Setup' wizard step.
  • Support for target form factors: Mobile (Phone), Tablet & Foldables (Navigation Rail), Android TV (D-pad Leanback & TabRow), and Universal Adaptive (BoxWithConstraints responsive layouts).
  • Customizable brand color palettes: Dynamic Material You, Ocean Blue, Emerald Green, Vibrant Purple, Sunset Orange, and Midnight Monochrome.
  • Configurable UI shape tokens: Rounded (Standard M3), Soft & Pill (Playful), and Sharp & Geometric (Technical).

1.0.5 - Android SDK 37 (Android 17) & Modern AndroidX AAR Compatibility

  • Updated default compileSdk to 37 to support latest AndroidX libraries (Compose BOM 2026.09, Navigation 2.10, Core-KTX 1.19, OkHttp 5.5, Activity 1.13, Hilt Navigation 1.4).
  • Resolved AAR metadata compileSdk 37 minimum version check failures across all generated modules and convention plugins.
  • Expanded Target SDK dropdown options to include Android 16 (36) and Android 17 (37).

1.0.4 - Gradle 9 & AGP 9.4 Compatibility & Modern Build Logic

  • Upgraded Gradle wrapper to 9.8.1 and AGP to 9.4.1 for out-of-the-box build reliability.
  • Modernized build-logic convention plugins using ApplicationExtension/LibraryExtension and Kotlin 2.x compilerOptions.
  • Eliminated redundant kotlin.android plugin declarations and resolved extension type conflicts.
  • Updated Version Catalog with latest dependencies: Kotlin 2.4.21, Compose BOM 2026.09, Hilt 2.60, KSP 2.3, Retrofit 3, Room 2.8.
  • Optimized gradle.properties with 8GB heap, configuration caching, and parallel sync tooling.

1.0.3 - Deprecated API Modernization

  • Replaced deprecated addBrowseFolderListener with modern TextBrowseFolderListener.
  • Clean, 100% verified compatibility across IntelliJ Platform 2024.1 through 2026.3+ with 0 API removal warnings.

1.0.2 - Universal Compatibility & Android Studio Native Support

  • Removed strict Java module requirement, ensuring native compatibility with Android Studio (Koala, Ladybug, Meerkat, Rabbit 1 2026.2+) and IntelliJ IDEA (2024.1 - 2026.x+).
  • Updated namespace and action bindings to prasad.vennam.awesomeandroidwizard.
  • Zero upper-bound limit for forward compatibility across all future IDE releases.

1.0.1 - Compatibility Update

  • Expanded IDE compatibility across all modern IDE releases: IntelliJ IDEA (2024.1+, 2024.2+, 2024.3+, 2025.x, 2026.x) and Android Studio (Koala, Ladybug, Meerkat, Rabbit).
  • Removed until-build barrier for forward compatibility.
  • Added custom vector icon and design system refinements.

1.0.0 - Initial Release

  • Initial release of Awesome Android Wizard on JetBrains Marketplace.
  • Multi-step interactive wizard supporting Clean Architecture MVI & MVVM.
  • Choice of Dependency Injection (Hilt or Koin) and Networking (Ktor or Retrofit).
  • Feature and Core module scaffolders with automatic Gradle wiring.
  • Integrated Awesome Project Doctor for diagnostics and architectural boundary enforcement.
  • Pre-configured Git pre-commit hooks and GitHub Actions CI workflow.

Scaffold a new MVI feature slice (Contract, ViewModel, Compose Screen, Navigation, and Unit Test)
Scaffold a Clean Architecture repository slice (Model, Network DTO, Mapper, Repository, and Test Fake)
Scaffold a Macrobenchmark and Baseline Profiles module for the Android project
